about.title: About Plademy
about.description: Plademy Oy — AI-powered platform for mentoring, coaching, and organizational development programs, based in Helsinki, Finland.
about.lead: Human-centered, AI-powered learning and development for organizations and communities.
about.body1: Plademy is an AI-driven platform that helps organizations design, run, and measure mentoring, coaching, training, onboarding, and other development programs — without relying on spreadsheets and scattered tools.
about.body2: We build product experiences such as Mentorship Center, Membership Center, and ERG Center, with secure integrations into HR, LMS, and collaboration tools.

page.title: ERG Center - Employee Resource Group Solutions
page.description: Comprehensive solutions for Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) to support diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives.
page.heroDescription: Empowering Employee Resource Groups with comprehensive solutions to build inclusive workplace cultures and drive meaningful change.
page.whatAreErgsDescription: Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) are voluntary, employee-led groups organized around shared identities, experiences, or interests. Originally pioneered by Xerox in the 1960s to address racial tensions, ERGs are now utilized by 90% of Fortune 500 companies to foster inclusive workplace cultures.
page.communityDescription: Providing safe spaces and a sense of belonging for employees from diverse backgrounds.
page.connectionDescription: Facilitating internal networking and camaraderie among employees with shared experiences.
page.careerDescription: Offering mentorship, skill-building, and leadership opportunities within the group.
page.changeDescription: Advocating for policy improvements and driving DEI initiatives across the organization.
page.benefitTalent: Talent Management: Improves recruitment, streamlines onboarding, and significantly increases retention
page.benefitInnovation: Business Innovation: Provides diverse perspectives that drive creativity and problem-solving
page.benefitInsights: Market Insights: Better understanding of diverse customer bases and market segments
page.benefitEngagement: Employee Engagement: Boosts morale and productivity by fostering a culture where employees feel heard and valued
page.benefitGrowth: Professional Growth: Access to executive sponsors, formal mentorship, and leadership roles
page.benefitSupport: Support Systems: Enhances well-being and mental health through mutual support
page.benefitAdvocacy: Advocacy: Provides a collective voice to influence company benefits and workplace accessibility
page.benefitNetworking: Networking: Builds meaningful connections with colleagues across the organization
page.solution1Description: Comprehensive platform to manage ERG memberships, events, communications, and activities all in one place.
page.solution2Description: Facilitate connections between ERG leaders and executive sponsors to ensure organizational support and alignment.
page.solution3Description: Organize and manage guest speaker events, networking sessions, professional workshops, and community activities.
page.solution4Description: Track member engagement, measure belonging, and demonstrate the value of ERG programs to leadership with comprehensive analytics.
page.solution5Description: Connect ERG members with mentors, provide skill-building opportunities, and support career development within the group.
